As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply! Overview This role specialises in providing remote technical support for Precisely software and solutions. You will provide technical support to customers, using problem determination and root-cause identification skills to diagnose and resolve issues.You will collaborate with other support teams to prioritise and drive problems through to resolution, while communicating clear action plans and updates to customers. You will also contribute to improving technical support tools, procedures and processes, and may have opportunities to share knowledge and mentor others within the team. The role contributes to delivering a high level of customer satisfaction and achieving the broader objectives of the Support organisation. What You Will Do Provides live support to customers that includes periodic weekend shifts for On Call Support. Responds to queries from customers and Professional services Consultants, via phone, email and web. Defines, analyzes, and resolves customer issues in a timely & accurate manner. Provides periodic updates to the customers, co-workers, and management on the status of outstanding issues. Updates status of issues in the incident tracking system and performs appropriate follow-up on escalated issues. Documents complex issue resolutions for both the customer and internal reference, following the appropriate support processes. Assists senior team members with complex issues to gain experience and exposure to more advanced problems. Responsible for ensuring that the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) between customers and Sterling are met consistently. Contributes, reviews and maintains knowledge base content on an ongoing basis. What We Are Looking For 2 - 4 years related programming or operations/technical support experience or consulting services. Excellent communication (oral and written), analytical and troubleshooting skills. OS experience in one or more areas of UNIX and/or Windows and/or LINUX and/or AS400. Database experience in one or more areas of Oracle and/or DB2 and/or MS SQL and/or MySQL. Knowledge in one or more areas of the following: Web Extensions and/or Tomcat (servlet engine) and/or Servlets and/or Apache (web server) and/or JSP and/or JavaScript and/or HTML. Java: Ability to read and step through an Object Oriented Language, preferably Java; Jdbc, Jdk, Jvm, stack traces. Knowledge in one or more areas of the following Protocols/Standards: http/https and/or ftp/sftp and/or SOAP and/or SMTP and/or POP and/or AS2 and/or Rosetta Net. Ability to take ownership of complex issues/assignments and follow through to completion. Demonstrates aptitude to prioritize and handle multiple issues simultaneously Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Understanding of Docker concept and ability to troubleshoot issues on docker platform. Ability to work with Virtual Machines. Knowledge on User Exits and Rest API. Exposure to IBM Sterling B2B Portfolio (Sterling B2B Integrator., B2Bac, Sterling File Gateway and Sterling Connect: Direct would be an advantage. Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment. Ability to function and contribute in team environment. Willing to work flexible hours. AA/AS in Computer Science or related technical experience. AI Skills/Knowledge Ability to leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Familiarity with AI-assisted log analysis and anomaly detection to speed root-cause identification. Openness to adopting AI-driven workflows as part of daily support operations. Application and Interview Impersonation Notice: Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated (“Precisely”) is unlawful. If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators. The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: pawaTech is looking for a Senior Infrastructure DevOps Engineer to join our Infrastructure team. In this role, you will help build and scale modern infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments, improve Infrastructure as Code practices, automate operational processes, and contribute to the development of internal platform services. You will join a highly technical team working on long-term infrastructure initiatives, including datacenter, development, Kubernetes platforms, infrastructure automation, and large-scale Terraform improvements. Compensation range: €5800 - €6300 monthly gross About us: pawaTech is a leading iGaming solutions provider, delivering sportsbook, casino, lottery, and player management software as a service. We power betPawa - Africa’s largest betting brand, operating across multiple markets. Our platform is designed for scale, handling millions of active users across web and mobile, processing thousands of transactions every second. With nearly a decade of industry expertise, we don’t just build software - we craft tailored solutions that drive innovation. Our expertise, commitment to quality, and client-focused approach make us a trusted partner in Africa and beyond. What you’ll be doing: Building and maintaining scalable infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments; Improving Infrastructure as Code practices; Automating infrastructure provisioning, deployments and operational workflows; Building and supporting Kubernetes infrastructure and internal platform services; Managing infrastructure reliability, scalability, security and performance; Working with networking components and infrastructure services; Collaborating with engineering teams on infrastructure architecture and operational improvements; Participating in incident management and continuously improving operational standards and automation processes. What makes you a great candidate: 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Platform Engineering roles; Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices; Experience working with Linux systems (Ubuntu), networking, and production infrastructure; Experience designing reliable and scalable infrastructure for production environments; Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure; Experience working with cloud providers such as AWS and GCP; Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, redundancy, and operational best practices; Experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps; Ability to work independently in a goal-oriented engineering environment; Strong ownership mindset and ability to make and explain technical decisions; Motivation for continuous learning and professional growth; Strong communication and collaboration skills. Extra expertise we appreciate: Experience with large-scale Terraform refactoring projects; Experience building internal platform engineering capabilities; Experience with hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure; Knowledge of production-grade network architecture and network equipment configuration; Experience working with scalable web application infrastructure hardware; Understanding of operational processes such as incident management, change management, and vulnerability management; Experience in introducing engineering standards and operational maturity practices. Why choose pawaTech? We make an impact and contribute to shaping of the iGaming culture; We offer growth inside dedicated teams of seniors and career prospects; We embrace a modern technological stack and an innovative approach; We value balance - a hybrid environment, wellness-related perks and team events are waiting for you; We play it fair with compensation that recognises and backs your achievements, team budgets and recognition milestone bonuses. This job is accepting ongoing applications, and there is no application deadline. At pawaTech, we are dedicated to building a welcoming and diverse workplace and invite applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, or other protected characteristics. Our hiring process ensures fairness, objectivity, and respect for every applicant. Applicants are welcome to redact or omit information from their resumes that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance or graduation from educational institutions. In compliance with EU GDPR standards and PDPA in Estonia, your personal data will be treated confidentially, used purely for recruitment, and accessible only to authorised hiring team members. Please visit our candidate privacy policy to learn more. For additional information regarding the processing of your data, please reach out via data.protection@pawatech.com

review_candidates.description: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO MANAGING DIRECTOR Location : Pune Employment Type : Full-Time Experience Level : 8 - 12 Years Working Hours : 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM Working Days : 6 Days ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced, high-ownership, and strategically minded Executive Assistant to Managing Director (EA to MD) with 8 to 12 years of multi-functional experience. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner and force multiplier to senior leadership.  You will bridge strategy and execution across key business verticals—including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, HR, and Customer Experience. Beyond executive operations, you will actively own and drive digital marketing strategies, content creation, brand positioning, and cross-functional growth projects.  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy Lead and oversee digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, SEO/SEM, and influencer networks to drive D2C customer acquisition and retain subscription users. Partner with growth teams and agencies to optimize Performance Marketing spend, ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). Direct email marketing campaigns, WhatsApp Business automation, push notifications, and app-based loyalty/retention workflows. • Content Writing & Strategic Communication Draft compelling copy for website, mobile app landing pages, product announcements, email newsletters, and promotional messaging. Own corporate communications, founder branding content (LinkedIn posts, industry thought leadership, media releases), and internal newsletter communications. Review, refine, and maintain brand voice across all digital touchpoints, customer communication channels, and packaging/collateral copy. • Strategic Business Operations & Cross-Functional Governance Act as a key strategic liaison between the Founder/Leadership and department heads (Logistics, Sales, Warehouse, Finance, Marketing, HR) to align project deliverables and monitor operational workflows.  Track company-wide OKRs/KPIs, ensure accountability across business units, and follow up proactively on critical corporate initiatives and milestone deliverables.  Lead high-priority ad-hoc strategic projects, market expansion studies, product launch readiness reviews, and process optimization initiatives.  • Executive Decision Support & MIS Management Consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly operational, sales, and financial performance metrics into actionable business intelligence dashboards and MIS reports.  Prepare high-level strategic decks, investor presentations, board meeting materials, and executive summaries (PowerPoint/Excel).  Analyze operational bottlenecks, unit economics, and last-mile delivery efficiencies to recommend actionable business improvements.  • Leadership Enablement & Workflow Oversight Manage complex schedules, prioritize appointments, organize leadership calendar, and ensure smooth daily time management for senior leadership.  Lead executive and cross-departmental reviews, document Minutes of Meetings (MoM) with clear owners, and rigorously track actionable points to closure.  Oversee executive communications, confidential records management, and strategic correspondence.  REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS • 8–12 years of progressive experience in Founder’s Office, Strategy & Operations, Brand/Digital Marketing, or Business Management roles. Prior experience in FMCG, Dairy, D2C, E-commerce, or Food & Beverage is strongly preferred.  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Commerce, or Strategic Communications.  • Solid understanding of performance marketing channels, D2C sales funnels, SEO/SEM, content strategy, and digital consumer engagement. • High proficiency in Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and MIS/data analytics frameworks.  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to write compelling copy and interface smoothly with senior stakeholders.  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, push projects across the finish line, and operate with high autonomy, confidentiality, and sound business judgment.

review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Join Our Team as Remote DevOps Engineer About Flexi At Flexi, we're dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation in the iGaming industry. Our cutting-edge infrastructure, hosted on Google Cloud, ensures a seamless gaming experience for our users. Join our team and be part of shaping the future of online gaming! Are you a seasoned DevOps Engineer looking to take full ownership of a modern cloud platform? Flexi, a leading Gaming company, is expanding its team and searching for a seasoned DevOps Engineer who doesn't just maintain infrastructure — they continuously evolve it. Key Responsibilities As a Remote DevOps Engineer at Flexi, you will own the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of our cloud platform. Your responsibilities will include: Designing, implementing, and owning end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with a focus on speed, reliability, and zero-downtime deployments. Architecting and fine-tuning highly available, fault-tolerant systems on Google Cloud — including load balancing, auto-scaling groups, multi-region failover, and disaster recovery strategies. Proactively managing cloud costs through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, autoscaling policies, and infrastructure spend analysis — with measurable impact on monthly GCP bills. Evaluating, onboarding, and deeply configuring new GCP-native and third-party services (e.g., Cloud Spanner, Memorystore, Pub/Sub, Cloud Armor, Vertex AI tooling) to meet evolving product needs. Owning Kubernetes cluster operations: tuning resource requests/limits, configuring HPA/VPA, managing node pools, and optimizing workload scheduling for both performance and cost. Building and enforcing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards using Terraform — no manual console changes. Defining and maintaining SLOs/SLIs, setting up alerting strategies, and driving incident response and post-mortems. Collaborating closely with development teams to shape architecture decisions, review infrastructure requirements, and advise on cloud-native design patterns. Leading container strategy: designing production-grade Docker configurations, multi-stage builds, and hardened base images for both local development and production environments. Partnering with QA teams to build robust test automation infrastructure and staging environments that mirror production fidelity. Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering role, ideally in a high-traffic or real-time product environment. Deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform — not just familiarity, but proven experience designing and tuning production workloads across GCP services. Strong command of Kubernetes in production: cluster tuning, resource optimization, network policies, RBAC, and persistent storage configuration. Demonstrated ability to reduce infrastructure costs — bring examples of cost optimization wins you've personally driven. Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) and GitOps workflows. Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python and/or Bash) for operational tasks, tooling, and custom integrations. Hands-on experience with observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Operations Suite) — building dashboards, defining alerts, and acting on data. Experience designing for high availability: understanding of replication, failover, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation patterns. Familiarity with security best practices: secrets management (Vault, GCP Secret Manager), network segmentation, IAM least-privilege, and vulnerability scanning in pipelines. Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent CI tooling is a strong plus. Ability to work autonomously, make architectural decisions independently, and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 🎁Benefits Competitive salary As a growing startup, meaningful opportunities for career growth and technical leadership. Direct influence over infrastructure decisions — no red tape. Health and wellness benefits. Collaborative and inclusive remote-first work environment. Our Unique Culture We are a remote team, but we like to meet at our Athens offices once in a while to catch up in person! We love working with people who take ownership and bring genuine enthusiasm to what they do. We hate micromanagement, traditional hierarchy, and KPIs. Ready to own the platform? Submit your resume and a cover letter. In your cover letter, tell us about a specific infrastructure challenge you solved — bonus points if it involved cost savings, reliability improvements, or onboarding a new service from scratch. Flexi is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Send your CV to: careers@flexi.tech Shape the future of online gaming with Flexi . Apply today.

review_candidates.title: Site Civil Quality – Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Established in 2002, ib vogt GmbH is specialized in the Development, Design and Engineering, Financing, EPC and Operation of solar power and provides turnkey solar power plant solutions to investors internationally. As a manufacturer-independent integrated developer, the company focuses on tailor-made solar power plant solutions that maximize lifecycle performance and returns. Since 2009, ib vogt has commissioned plants with a capacity of almost 2 Gigawatt. We employ over 840 specialists, in all areas of the solar power plant value chain in over 40 countries. The company operates internationally from offices in Spain Germany, Italy, Netherlands, France, Poland, USA, Australia, United Kingdom, Panama, India and Southeast Asia. Job Description Purpose/ Profile Summary : The Civil Engineer shall be responsible for the planning, supervision, inspection, coordination, and quality assurance of all civil and structural works to ensure the project is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with Philippine regulations, project specifications, and international engineering standards. Roles & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Supervise all civil and structural works for the solar PV plant, BESS facilities, 138 kV substation, and 17 km transmission line. Manage site development activities, including clearing, grading, earthworks, access roads, drainage systems, and erosion control measures. Ensure construction complies with approved drawings, technical specifications, NSCP, DPWH standards, and applicable Philippine regulations. Inspect and monitor concrete works, reinforcing steel installation, formworks, foundations, retaining structures, and structural components. Coordinate foundation construction for PV structures, BESS equipment, substations, transformers, and transmission line towers. Review and verify survey layouts, elevations, foundation locations, and as-built measurements prior to construction activities. Monitor construction progress against the approved schedule and recommend recovery plans for delays affecting civil works. Coordinate closely with electrical, mechanical, transmission line, QA/QC, HSSE, environmental, and commissioning teams to ensure seamless project execution. Review and witness quality inspections, material testing, compaction tests, concrete testing, and foundation acceptance in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Manage contractors and subcontractors to ensure adequate manpower, equipment, productivity, workmanship, and compliance with project requirements. Identify, assess, and resolve construction issues related to geotechnical conditions, drainage, structural integrity, constructability, and site access. Ensure proper implementation of construction safety requirements for excavation, heavy equipment operations, temporary works, lifting activities, and work at height. Review civil method statements, shop drawings, material submittals, and requests for inspection prior to execution. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, inspection records, non-conformance reports (NCRs), punch lists, and as-built documentation. Support project planning, cost control, quantity verification, variation assessments, and risk mitigation for all civil works. Coordinate with government agencies, consultants, Owner's Engineer, and EPC contractors to ensure compliance with permits, environmental requirements, and contractual obligations. Support testing, commissioning, and project handover by ensuring all civil works are completed, inspected, documented, and accepted before energization and commercial operation. Qualifications Qualification and Educational Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering Must be a Licensed Civil Engineer with a valid PRC License. Minimum of 5 years of relevant construction experience, preferably in utility-scale solar power plants, substations, transmission lines, or other energy infrastructure projects. Proven experience in site development, earthworks, reinforced concrete structures, roadworks, drainage systems, and foundation construction. Experience in 138 kV or higher substations, transmission line foundation works, or industrial infrastructure projects is an advantage. Knowledge of the National Structural Code of the Philippines (NSCP), National Building Code, DPWH Standard Specifications, and other applicable Philippine engineering standards and regulations. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, geotechnical reports, and construction schedules. Strong understanding of construction quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), inspection procedures, and material testing requirements. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with experience coordinating with EPC contractors, consultants, government agencies, and multidisciplinary project teams. Willing to be assigned full-time at the project site and work extended hours when required to meet project milestones. Possesses a valid driver's license (preferred) and is willing to travel to remote project locations as necessary. Preferred Experience: Experience in 100 MW or larger utility-scale renewable energy or power generation projects. Experience working on projects involving Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), high-voltage substations, or transmission lines. Experience in managing contractors and supervising multidisciplinary construction teams during EPC project execution Additional Information We Offer You Interesting and challenging tasks A truly international working environment with colleagues from all over the world An open-minded, friendly and highly motivated team. Great opportunities for professional and personal development competitive remuneration (based on experience) We know that no candidate ticks every box. If this role excites you and you believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. At ib vogt, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone can thrive. We believe that embracing diverse perspectives drives innovation and helps us better serve the global communities we operate in. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy or maternity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other protected status. We strive to create an accessible recruitment process for all candidates and are happy to discuss reasonable accommodations to support your application. As a global company, we acknowledge that accessibility provisions may vary by location depending on local infrastructure and legal requirements. If you have a disability or require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know - we will do our best to support you.
